about: The secreta of the formulary “Epiphany of the Lord” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Look graciously, we beseech Thee, O Lord, upon the gifts of Thy Church, wherein gold, frankincense, and myrrh are no longer offered, but He Whom those gifts declare is sacrificed and received: Jesus Christ, Thy Son, our Lord. Who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God,
